name: suture-crew
description: Always-on audits for Suture spreadsheet models: three agents map .suture.json lineage, run property-based Exorcist audits, and verify non-masking formula patches with zero regressions, with one-click Suture X-Ray replay links for human sign-off.
author: g4stein
highlights: Schema Archaeologist maps every sheet and the SQL → Python → formula lineage of your .suture.json models
Invariant Adversary runs Suture's Exorcist fuzzer and turns each shrunk counterexample into a Suture X-Ray replay link
Formula Surgeon proposes the upstream, non-masking fix and proves it with suture_verify_patch before suggesting a diff
A paused nightly-model-audit schedule you switch on once your workspace is set
A bundled sample workbook with a real discount-stacking bug, so the first audit works right after install
Reports land in a local ledger the Suture Crew dashboard reads; nothing leaves your machine
useCases: Before a board meeting, ask Invariant Adversary to audit the runway model and open the counterexample in Suture X-Ray
When an audit fails, ask Formula Surgeon for a fix that changes the upstream SQL instead of hiding the error, with 0 regressions proven
Turn on nightly-model-audit so every .suture.json in the workspace is fuzzed overnight and the dashboard shows what broke

crons.name: nightly-model-audit
crons.message: Nightly model audit. Call suture_list_workbooks on the workspace server (@suture-crew:suture) and record the result. Then run suture_run_audit on every .suture.json file it lists, with trustPython left unset, and record every report with suture_crew_record_audit (source 'workspace'). If the workspace lists no .suture.json files, audit the bundled sample on @suture-sample instead (source 'sample'). Finish with a short table: workbook, verdict, violated assertion, X-Ray link.
